_comment: Northgate Machining, served in the twin's own address space by `mes run-opc-sim --replay`. Objects and tag names match the generated CSV tables exactly. Read-only (`order_tag` null) because a replayed CSV cannot be written to - production still books, because a counter delta auto-starts a released operation.
_cycle_seconds: 60 / rate_per_min from line.json: Saw 22/min, Mill 18/min, Deburr 25/min. These are the ideal cycle times OEE performance is measured against - a guessed one turns performance into fiction, so they are derived, not invented.
_state_map: Same site decision as the bottling line, and the same consequences: starved and blocked are IDLE (healthy machine, nothing to do), changeover is SETUP (planned - must not count against availability), only a genuine fault is DOWN.
_tags: Each machine subscribes to everything its line publishes: the loader fills that in from the generated tags.json. Set extra_tags on a machine only to pin a hand-picked subset, which is what a real server needs.
